note: Every quarterly re-read of the PULS profile (scripts/ukrainian-frequency/scrape-puls-cefr.py run against puls.peremova.org), newest last. A re-read that finds the single-word senses unchanged leaves puls-cefr.raw.csv and every derived tier alone and is recorded here, so the review's quarterly clock (review/targets.mjs pulsTarget) starts again from its date. The license notice is read first, as the review plan requires.

rereads.result: Every single-word sense (id, lemma, guideword, level, part of speech, entry type) is identical to the 2026-07-23 snapshot; only page positions moved, because the profile now lists 63 fixed expressions (entry type 'фраза') among the words. None of the 63 is a single token, so none can join a list lemma. The expressions are kept verbatim in puls-cefr.expressions.raw.csv; the snapshot and every derived tier are unchanged.
rereads.scraper: the browse table's anchors changed from #meaning-N to #meaning_N and gained #fixed_expression_N; the scraper reads both and now stops on a page whose rows do not parse
